findings.message: The param tarefaId has effect select:tarefasParaAcao but no request fetches a single record and no method selects. Added public selectTarefasParaAcao(id | null) and the getter tarefasParaAcao, which picks the loaded row of tarefas.items by selectedTarefa. An id that is not loaded publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarTarefasParaAcaoError.
public selectTarefasParaAcao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public tarefasParaAcao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
